review: Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5) strict desktop end-user journey review, mapmaker prototype
target: http://127.0.0.1:8765/mapmaker/ (existing local preview, Python SimpleHTTP/0.6, no CSP header sent; no ephemeral CSP server was created)
browser: Playwright Chromium 1243 headless, --no-sandbox, fresh context per size/reopen
method: Blind UI run first (visible DOM, mouse, keyboard, screenshots viewed); only rdMapmaker.ready used by replay helper for waiting. Source read only after the UI run, for root cause + CRUD matrix.

status_legend.pass: task outcome achieved through UI as a user would
status_legend.partial: achieved only with workaround or with a material defect

journeys.task: Find tool icons with one click
journeys.repro: Load page at 1440x900; left rail shows Bewegen/Pinsel/Radierer/Stempel/Ort/Auswählen, 59x56 px buttons with text labels, aria-pressed and tooltips incl. shortcut.
Datei > Neue Karte … > Leere Karte (3 clicks). Dialog warns that the current map is replaced and suggests saving first.
journeys.notes: No size/aspect choice (fixed 2400x1600), title defaults to 'Neue Karte', no painted title on blank map.

journeys.repro: Werkzeug tab > material Land: 'Malt auf' switches from Gelände to Land (coast layer). Size slider to 400 px, drag three loops.

journeys.task: Paint forest + rock on the terrain layer
journeys.repro: After J03 choose Wald, then Fels: 'Malt auf: Land' stays. Strokes go into Land. Hiding Land (Ebenen > eye) removes land, forest, rock, river and road together. Workaround: Ebenen > click 'Gelände' row, then paint.
Same cause as J04: Fluss/Weg do not route to 'Flüsse & Wege'. Works after clicking that layer row manually.
Stempel > Bergkette + 'Streuen beim Ziehen', drag along rock; Vulkan click; scroll palette with wheel; Stadt/Dorf/Burg click.
journeys.notes: Size slider resets to the symbol default when switching symbols; ghost preview under cursor helps.

journeys.task: Create three named places with usable lore
journeys.repro: Ort > Stil/Ortsart > click map: inline editor with Name focused+preselected; type name; Kurzbeschreibung; Fertig. 544 chars typed -> 500 kept (counter 500/500, no other notice).
Orte tab > click 'Grauhain': map centres on it, tool switches to Auswählen, editor opens. Rename, change Stil, append lore; undo/redo shows 'Eigenschaften ändern'.

journeys.task: Delete + undo stamp and place (lore restored)
journeys.repro: Auswählen > click Vulkan > Entf; Undo toast 'Rückgängig: Löschen'. Castle via 'Auswahl löschen'. Eisenwacht place deleted and restored with identical lore.
Label 'Brückenfeste' overlapped town stamp. Auswählen click on overlap picks the label (top layer); drag moves label away; then stamp click/drag moves stamp.
journeys.notes: No pick-cycling or object list to reach a fully covered item; hover cursor stays 'default'.

journeys.repro: Label dblclick (Auswählen or Ort tool) opens editor but focus stays on canvas. Layer row dblclick: no inline field (also on already-active row). Pencil button rename works.

journeys.task: Understand project title vs painted title
journeys.repro: Header 'Kartentitel' -> 'Das Tarnland' renames files only; painted title needed a separate Ort label (Stil Reich, Nur Beschriftung, no pin). Starter: header 'Nordmark' leaves painted 'DIE SILBERMARK'; downloads named nordmark.rdmap.json / nordmark.png.
Datei > Als Datei speichern -> das-tarnland.rdmap.json (4,009,146 B). Toast 'Karte als Datei gespeichert.'; status pill shows 'Lokal gespeichert' (browser autosave).
Datei > Als PNG exportieren … (dialog explains PNG vs editable file and campaign import) > 1x -> das-tarnland.png 2400x1600 RGBA. Contains own title, three places, stamps; no starter labels.

journeys.task: Reopen in NEW context; verify visuals and lore
journeys.repro: Fresh context (starter loads) > Datei > Öffnen > saved file. Visual match, 5 layers, places list shows all 3 with exact lore; JSON has place.lore for each, painted title separate from meta.title. Status pill says 'Ungespeicherte Änderungen' right after opening.

journeys.task: Recover from accidental actions (undo/redo, layer delete)
journeys.repro: Undo/redo buttons and Ctrl+Z show labelled toasts. Deleting 'Flüsse & Wege' (no confirm) shows 'Strg+Z holt sie zurück'; undo restores content. Visibility toggles are undo steps.
Hide active Land, paint: toast '„Land“ ist ausgeblendet – blende die Ebene ein …', no pixels written. Same for stamps on hidden Symbole; hidden stamps are not selectable.
journeys.notes: Guidance is reactive; tool panel 'Malt auf: Land' gives no hidden-state hint beforehand.

journeys.repro: Brush active, mouse wheel over map: zoom 43% -> 73%, no stroke.

journeys.task: Space-hold pan while brush is active
journeys.repro: Click Pinsel tool (focus on button), hold Space, drag on map: a road stroke is painted; last undo = 'Pinselstrich'. With focus on canvas the same gesture pans (cursor 'grab').
Auswählen: drag on empty map pans the view (no marquee). Separate Bewegen tool. Cursor 'default' over selectable items.

journeys.task: Shortcuts must not hijack text input
journeys.repro: Typed 'Brückenfeste [Süd] - Hafen +1 vs. Eher' in name, 'Das Tarnland' in header: no tool/zoom change. Delete in name removes a character (place kept). Ctrl+Z in field = text undo only (marker move of volcano stayed).
Radierer (target Flüsse & Wege), 26 px pass over a 26 px road end: land intact, but a lighter streak/residue remains.

journeys.task: Layer CRUD: add, rename, reorder, opacity, delete
journeys.repro: + Malebene, pencil rename to 'Schattenwald', paint Wald, ↓, opacity 50%, trash + toast. New layer was inserted above Symbole (active after stamp selection), so paint covered the town stamp until moved down.

journeys.task: Open a file while there are unsaved edits
journeys.repro: Place a Bergkette stamp (status 'Ungespeicherte Änderungen'), Datei > Öffnen > pick saved file: no prompt, map replaced, undo disabled; the stamp is gone and the browser draft now holds the opened file.

Reload: 'Entwurf gefunden' with focus on 'Neue Startkarte'. 'Entwurf wiederherstellen' restores map (undo history cleared). Enter -> starter; first edit then overwrites the single draft slot (3rd reload offers 'Die Silbermark').

Stempel palette: 6 categories, ~40 symbols, labels+tooltips, no search/filter; visible palette 414/1144 px at 1440x900, 331 at 1280x720, 265 at 1280x720@125%; long labels truncated ('Nadelw…', 'Hohe Tan…').
Shift-click selects only one item; no marquee; no right-click menu; no lock; Orte list contains places only. Moving the town stamp leaves the 'Brückenfeste' place behind (no link).
See geometry.json and report table; fresh context per size, blank map, brush/stamp/place editor/layers/export dialog.

not_tested: Mobile/tablet/touch/pen pressure (out of scope by user priority)
Literal browser Ctrl+'+' zoom UI: 125% was emulated as CSS viewport / devicePixelRatio 1.25 (1152x720 and 1024x576)
Keyboard-only placement on canvas and screen-reader walkthrough
History budget exhaustion with many full-map strokes (source: 60 steps / 64 MB; not UI-verified)
Malformed/malicious import files (explicitly excluded; only normal saved files opened)
CSP behaviour (preview server sends no CSP header; no ephemeral CSP server built)
Multi-tab concurrent drafts in one browser profile
